summary: Phase 2 (Invoice A/B, Reports redesign with charts, Month-End ZIP bundle) verified end-to-end. 13/13 backend pytest cases passed and all frontend assertions (style toggle persisting axistra_invoice_style in localStorage, reports-page wrapper, 4 KPI tiles, 4 recharts SVGs, 10 report cards, reports-bundle button triggering a real /api/reports/bundle/month-end download with Content-Type application/zip) passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoice PDFs: both /api/invoices/:id/pdf (branded default) and ?style=minimal return %PDF magic — Puppeteer with /usr/bin/google-chrome works correctly, no HTML fallback observed.
Minimal invoice HTML (/api/invoices/:id/html?style=minimal) returns 'Tax Invoice' plus Billed To / Payment Trace / Legal & Tax sections as designed.

GET /api/reports/dashboard/charts?year=2026 returns all required keys (kpis with total_sales/total_expenses/gross_profit/net_profit/vat_progress_pct/vat_remaining_aed, monthly_trend, top_customers, payment_method_split, gateway_split) — all arrays non-empty with the 86-recharge production baseline.
All 4 report PDF exports (yearly-pl, vat-threshold, corporate-tax, bank-reconciliation) return valid %PDF; yearly-pl Excel export returns valid xlsx (PK magic).

Month-End ZIP bundle (/api/reports/bundle/month-end?year=2026&month=05) returns a valid ZIP with exactly 9 entries: 00-Cover-2026-05.pdf + 01..04 (yearly-pl, vat-threshold, corporate-tax, bank-reconciliation) × (.pdf + .xlsx). Every entry is verified by magic bytes — all PDFs start with %PDF and all xlsx start with PK.

Reports.jsx exposes all required data-testids (reports-page, kpi-sales/expenses/net-profit/vat, chart-monthly-trend/method-split/top-customers/gateway-split, report-card-*, reports-bundle). Clicking the bundle button hits /api/reports/bundle/month-end?year=2026&month=05 returning 200 application/zip and triggers a browser download (axistra-month-end-2026-05.zip).
Invoices.jsx invoice-style-toggle correctly persists selection to localStorage key 'axistra_invoice_style' ('minimal' / 'branded') on each click.
Regression: /api/wallets/overview still returns exactly 5 wallets and /api/chain/search returns 200 — no breakage from Phase 2.

Code review: reports.controller.ts has a small bug-free arch — uses Buffer/archiver streaming properly; bundle generator awaits archive.finalize() after all appends. exceljs autoFilter range correctly anchored at A4. report-template.ts shells out to /usr/bin/google-chrome explicitly (no fallback to HTML observed in tests).
seed_data_creation: None — used live production-baseline data (57 customers / 86 recharges). All assertions used existing invoice IDs and 2026 reporting period.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 acceptance criteria fully met. Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_reports.py can be reused — it covers invoice A/B (branded/minimal pdf + html), reports/dashboard/charts, all 4 report PDFs, yearly-pl Excel, full ZIP bundle (with namelist + per-entry magic checks) and wallets/chain regression. LocalStorage key for invoice style is 'axistra_invoice_style'. Bundle button triggers a real download (use page.expect_download). All recharts mount in ~3s; chart-method-split has 6 SVGs, chart-gateway-split has 8 SVGs (Recharts internals).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — verification iteration; no bugs detected.
